text: Take a few akshintalu in your hand and, remembering Shiva and Keshava in your mind, say this sankalpam.
“In this holy Karthika masam, for the grace of Shiva and Keshava, I perform this daily puja with devotion and faith.

I pray that everyone in our family is blessed with long life and good health, happiness and peace, and prosperity; that the troubles and obstacles in our lives are removed; and that we are given good thoughts and the strength to walk the right path.”
